checks: Exact independent Cartesian cohort and frozen protocol match
Same-source/input fresh smoke and development lineage
Episode plus four retained receipts SHA256 per episode
Evaluator truth transform independently reconstructs body position, height, tilt and goal distance
Full 40-second trace with correct pre-step and post-step timestamps
Trace-derived goal, contact, fall and stale outcomes
Queue and stream conservation, bounded joined writer
Capture/service timing, delayed response conservation, and actual delivered service p95
Strict final collection aggregates and paired outcomes agree

definitions.client_p95: within-episode p95 of actual client.track elapsed time including client I/O
definitions.contact: reported simulator contact flag independently aggregated from the retained trace; geometry was not rerun
definitions.coordinate_invalidation: logical wrapper continuity invalidation; separate from observed native map-ID change
definitions.fresh_accepted_pose: native_tracked wrapper acceptance is true, timestamp exists, and pre-step pose age is in [-1e-8,0.35] seconds; includes poses held across decisions
definitions.latency_hold: may hold a nonzero previous command; not necessarily a stopped robot
definitions.modeled_service_p95: within-episode p95 of delivered native response service; excludes any response pending at horizon
definitions.navigation: 750 pre-step decisions from 10.00 through 39.96 seconds per episode; initialization excluded
definitions.nonzero_command: maximum absolute command component > 1e-10, including motion holds and turning; not proof of physical progress
definitions.stale_fraction: native_stale_stop decisions divided by all navigation decisions

limitations: Two seed clusters; descriptive development results, no independent confirmation or population interval
Stereo always legacy-first, lidar always candidate-first; execution order confounded with pipeline within each method
Candidate service separation is modeled; simulator generation and evidence archival measured separately, not concurrent robot or end-to-end hardware latency
Simulated ideal 16-ring 3D lidar differs from physical planar RPLIDAR C1
Ground-truth body trajectory used only by independent outcome audit; not estimator or controller
